videos.title: Mystery Signal From Space
videos.description: Deep in the mountains of West Virginia, mysterious signal from deep space has been received by the Green Bank Observatory, home of the world's largest steerable radio telescope.

videos.title: Secret Nazi Planes
videos.description: Designed by Ernst Heinkel, the He 280 was capable of over 500 miles per hour. But as WWII raged the He 280 was nowhere to be seen; first flown in September 1940, it was two years ahead of Willy Messerschmitt's Me 262.
